rules.barriers: the 2 scale + 1 cells at forward 3, lateral -scale..scale
rules.direction: D uniform over N, E, S, W from the scenes stream after the Simulation seed
rules.food: the 3 x 3 cells centred at start + 5 D, row-major
rules.redraw: a draw failing the exposure predicate redraws the placement from the scenes stream, the Simulation seed kept, up to 100 draws
